Distance-sampling list:

Good news: the Advanced Distance Sampling book will imminently be=20
available in paperback. The publisher, Oxford University Press, are=20
selling it at UK=A324.95, which is less than half the price of the=20
hardback edition. Their UK web site is

to offer a further 20% discount on the above price. It appears that=20
this offer is valid to UK and non-UK buyers. More information below,=20
and at the web site:
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.book/advanced.html

Cheers,

- Len Thomas
Coordinator, Distance Development Project
